planets.name: K2-239 c
planets.description: Transiting planet of K2-239 with a 7.78-day year, found in 2018.

text.card: K2-239 c was found in 2018 by K2 as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 3 planets known around K2-239. Its orbit and size follow Díez Alonso et al. 2018's fit, the archive's default.
